summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #39. Added: (1) committed solver parity corpus fixture with 12 cases covering ties (earliest-wins), exclusions, measured-zero vs missing, zero-weight channels, weight scaling/flips, multi-cell grids, and the Elixir WeightedSquaredError doctest mirror (expected score 0.205); (2) SolverParityCorpusTests that load the corpus and assert WeightedSquaredErrorScorer/CompositionSolver selections, per-cell scores, and excluded counts exactly; (3) OpenAPIClientAdoptionTests — structural red tests that fail until swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime are declared in ColorComposerCore/Package.swift, the OpenAPI document (viamin/color_matching#110) is committed, and package sources use the generated client; (4) PaletteAPIClientWireContractTests — green wire/behavior locks (endpoints /api/v1/printer_profiles and /api/v1/colors?printer_profile_id=N, Accept JSON, trimmed bearer token, 401->unauthorized distinct error, non-2xx->badStatus, malformed->malformedResponse, testConnection semantics, baseURL/token exposure for re-auth) that the generated-client migration must preserve; (5) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md and docs/openapi-client-migration.md. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed here; the corpus itself was verified with an independent Python reimplementation of the Elixir semantics (all 12 cases: selections, scores, excluded counts match).
